namespace Aproda.Base;

using Microsoft.Inventory.Item;

pageextension 50901 "Item Card Transl. Test" extends "Item Card"
{
    layout
    {
        addlast(Item)
        {
            field("Region Responsible"; Rec."Region Responsible")
            {
                ApplicationArea = All;
                Caption = 'Region Responsible';
                ToolTip = 'Specifies the employee responsible for this item, e.g. Hans Maßrichter.';
            }
            field("Translation Remark"; Rec."Translation Remark")
            {
                ApplicationArea = All;
                Caption = 'Translation Remark';
                ToolTip = 'Specifies a free-text remark used for translation testing.';
            }
        }
    }

    actions
    {
        addlast(processing)
        {
            action(TranslationTestAction)
            {
                ApplicationArea = All;
                Caption = 'Run Translation Test';
                Image = TestReport;
                ToolTip = 'Runs the translation test messages for this item.';

                trigger OnAction()
                var
                    TranslationTestMgt: Codeunit "Translation Test Mgt";
                begin
                    TranslationTestMgt.ShowSingleParameterMessage(Rec."No.");
                    TranslationTestMgt.ShowFourParameterMessage(Rec."No.", Rec.Description, Rec."Region Responsible", WorkDate());
                end;
            }
            action(ReleaseAction)
            {
                // same source text as the table field "Release" and the codeunit label
                // "Release", each a different context class (Page|Action|Caption here):
                // completes the three-way ambiguity set, this is the verb/action reading
                ApplicationArea = All;
                Caption = 'Release';
                Image = ReleaseDoc;
                ToolTip = 'Releases the item so it can no longer be edited.';

                trigger OnAction()
                begin
                    Rec."Test Status" := Rec."Test Status"::Released;
                end;
            }
            action(SecondReleaseAction)
            {
                // second wave: reuses the exact source + context class
                // (Page|Action|Caption) of ReleaseAction above for a genuine tier-2
                // exact-reuse candidate; a distinct ToolTip keeps this dimension unmatched
                ApplicationArea = All;
                Caption = 'Release';
                Image = ReleaseDoc;
                ToolTip = 'Releases the second batch of items so it can no longer be edited.';

                trigger OnAction()
                begin
                    Rec."Test Status" := Rec."Test Status"::Released;
                end;
            }
            action(VersionInfoAction)
            {
                // third wave: Caption has no Unicode letter (digits and a period only) -
                // a genuine tier-1 invariant candidate in a new context class
                // (Page|Action|Caption), distinct from the existing Table/Codeunit cases
                ApplicationArea = All;
                Caption = '2.0';
                ToolTip = 'Shows the current test object version.';

                trigger OnAction()
                begin
                end;
            }
        }
    }
}
